title: Ron Johnson sees the Milky Way from a distance

tellings.quote: They say, "Ron, where would you like to go?" Said, "I'd like to see the Milky Way from a distance."

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, passes on a story he says he heard from a man named Ron Johnson. According to Cameron, someone asked Ron where he would like to go, and Ron said he would like to see the Milky Way, our home galaxy, from a distance. If true, it would mean a person was offered a trip far beyond Earth by whoever was asking.
